notes: cics-crucible condition-handling / hc-deedit-uctranst (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): EXEC CICS BIF DEEDIT (digits right-aligned, the negative zone, a rightmost zoned byte, LENGERR) and INQUIRE / SET TERMINAL UCTRANST with DFHVALUE CVDAs (INVREQ RESP2 43, TERMIDERR RESP2 1 / 23). Scenarios restate the crucible's terminal steps; the oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs.

scenarios.name: deedit
scenarios.why: BIF DEEDIT on IBM's two examples, a trailing minus, a 1-byte field and a zoned rightmost byte; LENGTH 0 raises LENGERR (RESP)

scenarios.name: uctranst
scenarios.why: INQUIRE TERMINAL UCTRANST returns the TYPETERM's UCTRAN as a CVDA; SET TERMINAL UCTRANST(DFHVALUE(..)) changes it; a bad CVDA is INVREQ RESP2 43; an undefined terminal is TERMIDERR (planned, X26: the bad CVDA 999 is SET #3 INVREQ RESP2 43; the undefined terminal ZZZZ is INQUIRE #4 and SET #4 TERMIDERR)

scenarios.name: lengerr-abend
scenarios.why: BIF DEEDIT with LENGTH 0 and no RESP: LENGERR's default action, abend AEIV

scenarios.name: unmatched-mode
scenarios.why: takes the EVALUATE arm no crucible scenario reaches: a mode no WHEN names (falls through)
